title: High-Throughput Mass Cytometry Staining for Immunophenotyping Clinical Samples
protocol: Locate and set aside sample vials in liquid nitrogen, for quick retrieval on the day of staining.
Make surface antibody master mixes, diluting in CyFACS.
Label cell-counting slides with sample identifier, one each per sample.
Label 15 mL conical tubes with sample identifier, one each per sample.
Fill 15 mL conical tubes with 12 ml of supplemented RPMI and put them in 4°C.
Place 15 mL conical tubes filled with supplemented RPMI in the water bath.
Prepare a liquid waste container with 5 mL of 10% bleach.
Fill two large ice buckets with ice.
Thaw each sample vial one at a time in a 37°C water bath for approximately 45 seconds until just melted.
Pipette contents of the vial into the appropriate, prelabeled 15 mL conical tube.
Count cells and record viability and total cell/mL.
Mix 15 μL of cell suspension with 15 μL of trypan blue for a 1:1 mixture.
Load 20 μL of 1:1 mixture onto cell counting slide.
Insert cell counting slide into Cellometer and count.
Centrifuge all samples at 757 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Keep samples on ice after centrifugation.
Calculate how much volume is needed to resuspend all samples to 5 million cells/mL.
Ensure that there is enough reference sample after counting.
Prepare approximately 20 million ex vivo reference cells for an 80-sample experiment.
Prepare approximately 20 million stimulated reference cells for an 80-sample experiment.
Collect 2 million cells from each of the reference sample stimulation conditions (ex vivo and stimulated) to run as separate solo wells.
Splice 0.5 million of a 1:1 ex vivo and stimulated mixed reference sample into each experimental sample.
Viability stain the samples approximately 1 hour before analysis.
Stain experimental samples and reference sample for viability using Rhodium-103 (103Rh) barcoded with CD45.
Prepare a master mix of 103Rh and RPMI diluted to a final concentration of 1:500.
Calculate the volume of 103Rh-RPMI master mix needed based on the required cell concentration, rounding up ≈20% for overhead.
Decant supernatant from reference sample conical tubes.
Add appropriate volume of 103Rh-RPMI master mix to reference samples to achieve a final cell concentration of 5 million cells/mL.
Pipette up and down to disrupt the cell pellet in reference samples.
Dilute CD45_89Y at a ratio of 1:200 and add it to reference samples suspended in 103Rh-RPMI.
Add CD45_141Pr at a dilution of 1:1000 to remaining experimental samples suspended in 103Rh-Media.
Decant supernatant from experimental samples.
Add appropriate volume of CD45_141Pr-103Rh-Media to resuspend each sample to 5 million cells/mL.
Incubate samples for 15 min at 37°C in the water bath.
Bring volume in each conical tube up to 10 mL with CyFACS after incubation is finished.
Centrifuge samples at 757 × g, 3 min, 4°C.
Decant supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in 10 mL CyFACS by gently pipetting up and down.
Centrifuge samples again at 757 × g, 3 min, 4°C.
Calculate volume needed to resuspend cells to a concentration of 15 million cells/mL without factoring in any cell loss.
Resuspend samples to 15 million cells/mL with CyFACS.
Plate experimental and reference samples in a 96-well v-bottom plate.
Add 1.5 million cells (100 μL) of experimental sample to appropriate wells.
Add 2 million cells (133 μL) of ex vivo sample to ex vivo alone wells.
Add 2 million cells (133 μL) of stimulated sample to stimulated alone wells.
Combine the remaining ex vivo and stimulated reference samples in a 1:1 ratio.
Add 0.5 million cells of 1:1 mixed reference sample (33 μL) to each experimental well.
If an experimental sample’s cell number is insufficient, add more 1:1 mixed reference sample to reach a final cell number of 2 million total cells and a total volume of 133 μL in the well.
Add 67 μL of CyFACS to each well containing sample (total 200 μL/well).
Centrifuge the samples at 757 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Prepare FcR blocking reagent by diluting it 1:10 with CyFACS.
Add 15 μL of diluted FcR blocking reagent to each well and mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min on ice.
Remove surface master mix from 4°C (prepared the day before).
Filter the surface master mix with a 0.1 μm spinfilter in the microcentrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Measure the filtered master mix volume and adjust to original volume with CyFACS.
Keep adjusted master mix at 4°C until ready to add to samples.
After FcR blocking incubation is up, add 25 μL of filtered surface master mix per sample.
If staining with multiple antibody panels, add that specific surface master mix to the appropriate samples only.
Incubate for 45 min on ice after adding the surface master mix.
Add 150 μL of CyFACS and centrifuge at 757 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Wash once with 200 μL PBS.
Prepare reagents: 1× Fix I Buffer
Dilute 5× Fix I Buffer with PBS to make a 1× working stock of Fix I Buffer.
Add approximately 200 μL of 1× Fix I to each sample and incubate for 10 minutes at 23°C.
Thaw 4 full sets of 20 Pd-isotope barcodes for 10 minutes at 23°C until fully thawed.
Centrifuge barcodes using the PCR tube adapter in a mini-centrifuge (approximately 5 seconds).
Centrifuge samples at 935 × g for 3 minutes and decant supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 200 μL of 1× Barcode Perm Buffer.
Centrifuge samples at 935 × g and decant supernatant.
Repeat wash by centrifuging samples at 935 × g, decanting supernatant, resuspending in 200 μL of 1× Barcode Perm Buffer.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL of 1× Barcode Perm Buffer.
Resuspend barcodes in 100 μL of 1× Barcode Perm Buffer.
Transfer 100 μL of resuspended barcodes to samples and gently mix by pipetting.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 23°C.
Centrifuge samples at 935 × g for 3 minutes and wash samples twice with 200 μL of CyFACS.
Add 1 mL of BD Cytofix/Cytoperm to each 15 mL conical tube containing the barcoded samples.
Incubate for 20 minutes at 23°C.
Add 10 mL 1× Perm Wash to each sample and centrifuge (935 x g, 3 min).
Wash 1× with 10 mL of 1× Perm Wash.
Decant and use a pipette to aspirate after the last Perm Wash to leave pellet as dry as possible.
Filter intracellular antibody master mixes with a 0.1 μm spinfilter in a microcentrifuge: 14,000 × g, 5 min, 4°C.
Measure the master mix volume after filtering and adjust to the original volume with 1× Perm/Wash.
Keep at 4°C until ready to add to samples.
Add 100 μL of intracellular master mix to each barcode batch.
Incubate for 30 min on ice.
Add 10 mL of CyFACS and centrifuge (935 × g, 3 min).
Decant supernatants.
Resuspend pellets with 10 mL PBS.
Centrifuge at 935 × g for 3 minutes.
Decant supernatants and store samples on ice.
Prepare a fresh batch of 2% formaldehyde fix (FA) solution.
Dilute fresh 16% Paraformaldehyde (PFA) with PBS.
Vortex the cell pellet for 15 seconds.
Add 5 mL of 2% FA solution to each barcode set of samples.
Vortex for 30 seconds, thoroughly disrupting the pellet.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 23°C.
Thaw the DNA intercalator at room temperature for about 5 minutes until fully thawed.
Centrifuge samples at 935 × g for 3 minutes after incubation.
Add the DNA intercalator to 2% PFA at a ratio of 1:5000.
Add 1 mL of 2% PFA + DNA intercalator to each barcode batch and resuspend cells.
Count samples for cell concentration of each barcode batch.
Pipette 20 μL of cell suspension (in 2% PFA + DNA intercalator) into a cell counting slide, labeled with the respective barcoding batch.
Count (using “total concentration” assay) and record cells/mL.
Retrieve samples from 4°C storage.
Resuspend and transfer contents from 15 mL conical tubes into labeled 1.7 mL Microcentrifuge Tubes for washing.
Centrifuge samples for 5 minutes at 800 × g at 23°C.
Aspirate supernatant by pipette.
Add 1 mL Cell Staining Buffer (CSB) to each sample and pipette or vortex to resuspend.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 800 × g at 23°C.
Aspirate supernatant by pipette.
Add 1 mL Cell Acquisition Solution (CAS) to each sample and pipette or vortex to resuspend.
Label additional 1.7 mL Microcentrifuge Tubes for each sample.
Aliquot approximately 750,000 - 1 million cells from each sample into the respective additional 1.7 mL Microcentrifuge Tubes.
Bring total volume of each aliquot up to 1 mL in CAS.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 800 × g at 23°C.
Aspirate supernatant from all Eppendorf tubes and leave pelleted at 4°C until ready to acquire.
Prepare stock of 1:5 EQ Bead/CAS mixture by combining 4 mL EQ Beads with 16 mL CAS in a 50 mL conical tube.
Vortex to mix the EQ Bead/CAS mixture thoroughly.
Resuspend one sample aliquot in 1 mL of EQ Bead/CAS mixture.
Filter the resuspended sample through a 35 μm blue filter cap into a polypropylene FACS Tube.
Acquire each sample for 7200 seconds, with each aliquot being acquired one at a time for approximately 30 minutes each.
Adjust concentration with 1:5 EQ Bead/CAS mixture if necessary to achieve an acquisition rate of 300–350 events per second.
Once samples have been acquired, normalize the files in CyTOF software.
Concatenate the files (if necessary) and debarcode them in CyTOF software.
Aspirate cell pellet to be as dry as possible before further processing.
Start up and tune the instrument simultaneously with sample washing.
Wash two groups of samples initially for longer acquisitions.
Wash the remaining two groups of samples when 45 minutes remain before initial sample acquisition completion.
Leave samples in the DNA-Ir step for stable storage if they will be run later.
